column2: hero section over a full-bleed cinematic film frame of a low camera over wet sand at blue hour toward a woven fishing basket at the tide line, wooden boats soft in the haze; restrained text at bottom-left: small kicker "Sal Marinho, Goa", huge serif headline "From the coast.", one sub line "Every story here begins at the water, with the tide and the morning catch.", and a text link "Enter the experience" whose arrow rides a drawn wave line; minimal nav on top: wordmark "SAL MARINHO" left, "Menu" and a small terracotta pill "Reserve your table" right; composition anchor bottom-left over image

manifesto statement section, centered oversized serif statement "Not another seafood restaurant." across two lines, beneath it two short lines of sans copy "The coast gives us the catch. Fire gives it character.", solid volcanic ground with faint clay grain and a single thin terracotta hairline, generous negative space; composition anchor stacked center

process section "The fattening ritual": a vertical rhythm-line rail running down the left third with 7 waypoint ticks labelled Coast, Selection, Fattening, Preparation, Fire, Clay, Table; to the right, large macro photographs of a mud crab shell and hands selecting crabs in layered offset crop frames; small kicker "The crab"; a circular badge with the words "Follow the ritual" set on a circular path around a crab-shell line glyph; composition anchor top-left lead

horizontal panorama gallery section "The coast": a wide strip of tall cinematic coastal photographs side by side (Konkan cliffs, a Goa beach with wooden boats, Malabar backwaters, a Coromandel fishing village, an old Portuguese-era port) with region names in serif under each, deep forest green #1F2E24 ground, a thin wave line connecting them; composition anchor image-as-canvas

full-bleed media band: a wood fire pit with a blackened claypot on glowing coals filling the whole frame, embers floating, large serif statement set bottom-right "Cooked the old way. Served a new way."; duotone-graded atmospheric photo; composition anchor bottom-right over image

restaurant menu section "What's cooking?" as hover-accordion vertical slices: 8 tall narrow slices side by side labelled in rotated serif type (From the sea, The crab table, From the fire, The claypot, Coastal classics, Portuguese coast, From the land, Something sweet); one slice expanded wide showing a steaming crab dish in a claypot on a deep ocean blue #1D4250 ground with small sans details "Origin: Coastal India", "Technique: Wood fire and claypot", "Crab, coconut, spice, aromatics" and a link "Discover the dish"; small kicker "Menu"; composition anchor off-grid offset

storytelling section "The Portuguese connection": an aged old-map style illustration in smoked brown #4A3426 and clay ink on a charcoal ground, a dotted terracotta sea route from Lisbon around Africa to India's west coast with 5 waypoints (Portugal, Coastal trade, India, Local ingredients, Modern interpretation), an azulejo-inspired line pattern border, small ingredient line illustrations (chilli, cashew, vinegar, coconut), a text link "Trace the route" whose arrow rides the route; composition anchor inverted classic

layered crop frames section "The claypot": a macro photograph of a dark earthen claypot with its lid lifted slightly above it and steam rising, presented in two overlapping offset crop frames, serif headline "Slow heat. Sealed aroma." and one line of sans copy, charcoal ground; composition anchor centered with image

filmstrip section "Come for the crab. Stay for the story.": a horizontal strip of 8 tall narrow cinematic frames showing restaurant moments (arriving under tropical leaves, reading the menu, choosing, watching the fire, smoke, lifting a claypot lid, tasting, lingering at a candlelit table) with tiny serif captions under each, large serif headline above at left; composition anchor top-left lead

editorial magazine section "From our kitchen journal", off-grid layout: one large lead story image (hands cracking a crab claw) with serif title "Why crab tastes different when it's fattened", two smaller offset stories "The ancient art of cooking with fire" and "Why claypots change the dish" with category labels (The crab, The fire, The ingredient), a text link "Read the journal" with a waveform underline; composition anchor off-grid offset

diagonal staggered masonry gallery of a Balinese-inspired coastal restaurant interior: natural stone walls, dark wood beams, bamboo, tropical foliage, a reflecting pool, warm lantern light, an open fire kitchen; one short serif caption "Where the coast comes alive."; no other text; composition anchor bottom-left

closing reservation band: giant serif display text "The fire is lit." filling the width with flickering fire footage masked inside the letterforms, below it a call to action shaped like a kitchen order chit with a perforated edge reading "Reserve your table", volcanic ground; composition anchor centered statement

full menu page "What's cooking?": category tabs across the top (From the sea, The crab table, From the fire, The claypot, Coastal classics, Portuguese coast, From the land, Something sweet), below a grid of 3 story dish cards with large food photos (claypot crab, fire-grilled fish, cast-iron prawns), each card with serif dish name and small labels Origin, Influence, Technique, Ingredients and a price in rupees, one card hovered with a warm fire glow; composition anchor top-left lead

documentary-style page hero "The fattening ritual": extreme macro photograph of a mud crab claw with water droplets, serif headline, a step sequence rail across the bottom with 7 small waypoint labels (Coast, Selection, Fattening, Preparation, Fire, Clay, Table), scientific and culinary documentary feel with thin measurement hairlines; composition anchor image-as-canvas

full-screen minimal reservation overlay on volcanic black: serif heading "Reserve your table", four fields stacked with labels above (Date, Time, Guests, Special request) and hairline underlines, a round terracotta wax-seal style stamp button "Confirm", a faint ember glow along the bottom edge; composition anchor stacked center
